overview_description.description: Autosana offers an AI-powered mobile app quality assurance platform that automates end-to-end testing using natural language instructions. Teams can describe test scenarios without writing code, and Autosana generates and runs the tests across iOS and Android environments. The tool integrates with CI/CD pipelines, adapts to interface changes through self-healing tests, and provides session replays for visual verification and debugging. It supports app frameworks like React Native, Flutter, Swift, and Kotlin, aiming to reduce the time and effort spent on manual or brittle automated testing.
